Name: Sebastian's Frog Friend
Author: orochifrogu
Description:
[size=4]UPDATE v2.0.0: adds Sebastian's friend to his portraits! You'll now see a tiny little frog on Sebastian's shoulder who has the cutest expressions <3[/size]

[size=4]Check out [url=https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=jfRFImvjiRs]this youtube video[/url] where I showcase this adorable frog mod!!! Short on time? try [url=https://www.youtube.com/shorts/6odfd8KS3eg]this youtube short![/url][/size]

Sebastian's loneliness got you down? How about you give him a permanent best friend- in a small frog variety!

inspired by a comment on my reddit post by BillieChaosCat-TTV

This is an adorable mod that adds a tiny frog to Sebastian's character sprites and portraits (it uses Sebastian's vanilla style). Frog will hop around town beside Sebastian, and go wherever he goes- to the beach, every festival, his wedding, and even will be there on Sebastian's 14 heart event :)

WILL THIS MOD WORK IF YOU HAVE ANOTHER CHARACTER PORTRAIT AND SPRITE MOD?
- No! They wont 'combine'. Whichever gets loaded into SMAPI first will be shown, so at the moment this mod is only for people who want and use Sebastians VANILLA character style


HOW TO INSTALL:
1. ensure u have SMAPI and Content Patcher installed
2. download my file
3. unzip my file into your 'Mods' folder
Sebastian will now have a cute friend in his portraits and character sprites

SHOULD YOU REQUIRE ANY ASSISTANCE PLEASE REACH OUT! i'd love to help troubleshoot!!! <3 <3 

WHAT ELSE AM I WORKING ON?
-I am adding to my "Cute ___" universe of furniture! Soon, a recoloured version (muted down tones) will be released, then: single beds, cribs + childs beds, couches are all up next!
-ANOTHER new tiny frog mod that I think you're going to LOVE!!! If you like this one, stay tuned!!! (track my profile if you so please!)
-I just uploaded my first horror mod for Behelit Lewis, and I'll be bringing Guts from Berserk into the game as well
-Many more characters would do well with a trip to the salon... so thats exactly what I'll be working on as well <3 

Thats about it! I just love making mods and doing pixel art, it makes me so happy! I'm filled with such happiness when I see that somebody is out there using the art that I create in their playthrough <3 i hope my mods can bring you joy, or at least, a smile :)
